standard: NOT x402-compatible: x402 exact settles ASA/SPL/ERC-20 tokens only, this settles native ALGO

payload.txn: <base64 msgpack SignedTransaction of a native pay>

transaction_rules: type must be pay and the transaction must not be grouped
note must be exactly accepts[].extra.paymentId encoded as ASCII
rekey_to and close_remainder_to must be empty
last_valid_round must not have passed at settlement time
genesis hash must match the advertised network

error_codes.unknown or expired paymentId: paymentId missing from note, or challenge expired
error_codes.paymentId already used: single use; request a fresh challenge
error_codes.settlement failed: network rejected the transaction (signature, funds, already in ledger)
